text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: service-canary failing (error rate spike > 15% for canary group). Alert: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE in logs at the tokenization-infer path.
camille: noticed the alert, shifting to oncall. grabbing context.
ajay: deploying 2026-03-17T11:05 release to canary now, which flipped ENABLE_KMS_V2=true and updated KMS_KEY_ALIAS to alias/redwood/rotated-2026.
ken: oncall here. can you paste the failing log lines?
ajay: logs pasted: 
```
2026-03-17T11:12:03Z ERROR infer-service: decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: User "svc-infer-role" is not authorized to decrypt with key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-rotated
```
marta: seeing same stack traces in the canary cluster. all canary replicas are returning 500 on init. latency also spiking.
lina: are we sure the alias points to the rotated key id? I thought rotations were scheduled last week.
ajay: yes we rotated keys yesterday but forgot to add svc-infer-role to the new key's decrypt policy. the alias was updated by infra/rotate-keys job.
ken: impact assessment? only canary traffic so far? any customer-facing errors?
camille: telemetry shows ~20% of production requests routed to canary due to burst policy — some customers hitting inference timeouts. support tickets incoming. marking P1.
ops-bot: Added incident:INC-2026-112 to tracker. Incident commander: ken.
ken: immediate mitigation: kill the feature flag that enables KMS_V2 so canary reverts to previous env behavior. ajay, can you flip the flag and restart the canary pods?
ajay: flipping flag now: ```curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"enable_kms_v2","value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```
ajay: flag flipped :white_check_mark:. initiating rolling restart of canary deployment: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-canary -n prod-canary`
marta: restarting. pods coming up but still failing because ENV KMS_KEY_ALIAS is present in the container environment from the new image. need env override or rollback of the deploy.
ken: plan B: set env var KMS_KEY_ALIAS to previous alias via k8s patch to avoid immediate redeploy. ajay, can you patch the canary deployment to set KMS_KEY_ALIAS=alias/redwood/prev?
ajay: running: `kubectl set env deploy/infer-canary KMS_KEY_ALIAS=alias/redwood/prev -n prod-canary`
ajay: patch applied, pods are re-creating.
lina: watching logs — decrypt errors drop immediately. healthchecks now passing.
camille: traffic normalized back to baseline. support notified to pause onboarding of affected customers.
ken: good. next steps: 1) rollback image to previous tag or finalize permission fix on new KMS key; 2) update key policies to include svc-infer-role if we want to keep rotated key; 3) postmortem + automation to ensure key rotation updates IAM/policies and flags remain coordinated.
ajay: I'll open PR to add svc-infer-role to the new key policy and a verification job that tests decrypt using service credentials. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4823
marta: also adding a pre-deploy check in the deploy pipeline to validate key alias -> keyid mapping and IAM decrypt permission using a dry-run.
camille: handing off incident to postmortem owner marta. ken, thanks for IC.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-112 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
ken: ngood job. I'll stay on-watch for 30m then handoff to next oncall.
lina: leaving a note in #support: "Canary had transient decrypt errors due to rotated KMS key missing decrypt policy; mitigation applied by disabling KMS_V2 feature flag and patching env. Rolling fix PR open."
ajay: will follow up with final rollback of the canary image to prev stable tag once PR merges.
marta: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll include deployment runbook updates as action items.
camille: closing thread updates when incident is fully resolved. great quick coordination everyone. :thumbsup:
